Various DECOCTIONS/KASHAYA
Various DECOCTIONS/KASHAYAS
Water based Decoctions made from Spices/ Condiments/ Leaves/ Parts of herbs are to be taken in morning, afternoon and evening.
(Diseases like Cancer also have specific decoctions in pre-lunch/afternoon times).
